primitiveBudget: one generated faceted 3D loop, 36 longitudinal segments, 9 cross-section facets, one inner aperture, four liftable compilations
commitThreshold: a closed trace with sufficient area and length
memoryRule: the provisional trace remains geometry-neutral; closure rewrites the loop's own twist, aperture, depth, shear, phase, and facet grammar; four compilations persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch draws a closed loop and releases; Enter or Space compiles a deterministic loop; Delete lifts latest; Escape releases
representationRupture: Canvas 2D decision fields and pressure slabs -> generated p5.js WEBGL faceted loop object
compositionRupture: distributed panels, channels, and remote receivers -> one self-contained volumetric loop with an aperture
encounterRupture: select, cross, contradict, or depart -> enclose a form in one closed trace
temporalRupture: remote answer after a visit -> provisional trace becomes a compiled revision only at closure
mediumRupture: Canvas 2D leaves and channels -> WEBGL faceted volume with generated depth and interior void
changedRule: Pressure becomes compilation: only a closed loop can edit the production rule of the form that generated it, and winding becomes structural direction.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one faceted three-dimensional loop. Each valid closure changes actual volume, aperture, depth, and face rhythm; opposite winding produces a different mode.
falsifier: Delete if an open trace commits, if the trace only paints a scar, if winding is cosmetic, if later compilations reset, if the blind object reads as a generic torus, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v045 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish self-modifying compilation from a static 3D loop or if closure is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
